title: RoboAda: Adapting Frozen Robot Policies at Test Time to Physics They Cannot See
abstract: arXiv:2611.30209v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained robot policies decide what to do from camera images, yet some of the physics that decides whether their plans succeed is not visible. An object may look light but be 100 times heavier, and a weakened joint or a lagging controller leaves no trace in the image. When the physics at deployment differs from training, the plan is often still right but is executed as if nothing had changed. Training on such variations in advance cannot handle unseen changes, while adapting once deployed either changes the plan, leaving the miscalibrated commands in place, or updates a robot model by gradient steps that do not know how reliable they are and can make the robot worse even when nothing has changed. We propose RoboAda, which keeps the policy and its plan unchanged and corrects the commands that carry it out by inferring at test time how the robot turns commands into motion. translated_title: RoboAda：在测试时将冻结的机器人策略适配到其无法看见的物理特性
translated_abstract: 预训练的机器人策略通过摄像头图像来决定行动，然而决定其计划能否成功的某些物理特性是看不见的。一个物体看起来很轻，但实际可能重100倍；关节变弱或控制器滞后也不会在图像中留下任何痕迹。当部署时的物理环境与训练时不同，计划本身往往仍然正确，但执行时却仿佛什么都没发生。提前在这些变化上进行训练无法应对未见过的变化，而部署后的适应方式要么改变计划本身，使未校准的命令继续存在；要么通过梯度步骤更新机器人模型——这些步骤并不知道自身有多可靠，即使环境没有变化也可能让机器人表现变差。我们提出RoboAda，它保持策略及其计划不变，通过在测试时推断机器人如何将命令转化为运动，来修正执行计划的命令。关键观察是机器人自身的运动揭示了……
tldr: RoboAda通过在测试时利用机器人自身运动来推断不可见的物理变化（如未知的物体重量或关节弱化），在不改变预训练策略计划的前提下修正执行命令，使机器人策略无需重新训练即可适应部署时未见过的物理环境。
en_tdlr: RoboAda adapts frozen pretrained robot policies at test time to invisible physics (e.g., unseen object weight or weakened joints) by inferring from the robot's own motion how commands translate into motion, correcting executed commands while keeping the policy's plan unchanged.
